annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家税务总局 (State Taxation Administration of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Taxpayers must file export refund/exemption registration with the competent tax authority and update it within 30 days of changes.
Sets declaration materials for production enterprises and foreign trade enterprises under the exemption-credit-refund and exemption-refund methods.
Requires retention of record-filing documents for ten years and foreign exchange receipt evidence rules.
Provides for suspension, recovery of refunds and penalties of 1-5 times the amount for fraudulent export tax refunds, with suspension of refund rights up to three years.
Takes effect 1 January 2026 and repeals STA Announcement 2012 No. 24.
annotation.summary_en: China's State Taxation Administration announcement issuing the Administrative Measures for VAT and Consumption Tax Refund (Exemption) on Export Business, effective 1 January 2026. It covers registration, declaration, certificates, document retention, verification and penalties. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
